en: The postcard shows a black and white photograph of a winter scene with many people ice skating on a frozen pond or lake. The background features a large building with two pointed towers and a columned porch, surrounded by leafless trees. The area is bustling with skaters and spectators, suggesting a popular public location. The overall style and fashion of the people indicate an early 20th-century setting.
